Amazon EC2 C8gn instances are now available in AWS Europe (Paris) region
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8gn instances, powered by the latest-generation AWS Graviton4 processors, are available in the AWS Europe (Paris) region.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports fine-grained access control
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports fine-grained access control (FGAC), enabling you to enforce per-user and per-tenant memory isolation through AgentCore Gateway without building custom authorization logic.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports flexible namespace variables
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now lets developers define flexible namespace variables to scope long-term memories along any application-specific dimension - such as organization, tenant, team, or environment - without creating duplicate…

items.title: AWS Transform now in scope for FedRAMP Class C
items.blurb: AWS Transform is now in scope for FedRAMP Class C (formerly Moderate baseline) in the US East (Ohio) Region. You can now use AWS Transform to build applications and run workloads that are subject to FedRAMP Class C compliance requirements.

items.title: Google Cloud Launches AI-powered Agents to Simplify Database Lifecycle Management
items.blurb: Google Cloud has introduced AI-powered Database Operations Agents, featuring an Onboarding Agent that streamlines database setup and an Observability Agent that helps automate troubleshooting, performance optimization, and tuning.
